parameters.unit: mean within-waterbody satellite-minus-field native-band NIR Rrs, averaged equally across named waterbodies, sr^-1
parameters.assumption_rationale: Each country-plus-waterbody label contributes once to the statistic after averaging all its paired matchups. The bootstrap resamples these 37 named waterbodies as a descriptive conditional approximation. Same-country/spatial dependence, field-method heterogeneity and archive selection may violate independence, so the interval is not a population-wide confidence statement. No null-hypothesis p-value is computed.

limitations: One locally fixed descriptive outcome; earlier AquaCorr outcomes were already seen.
The interval resamples named waterbodies as if independent and representative; this is not guaranteed.
The interval is conditional on a selected archive subset and does not establish population-wide bias.
Pairing does not remove time, geometry, atmospheric-correction or field-measurement error.
